original_finding_content.subject: Trustpilot Star Seller reports permanent ban from overnight policy change
original_finding_content.raw_text:
**What:** Star Seller with perfect 5/5 reviews reports being permanently banned overnight due to a policy change regarding plastic props, with no opportunity to remove items or comply, subsequently discovering Chinese sellers copying their images and using AI to replicate their likeness.
**Verbatim snippet:** "I was an honest seller on etsy that was a star seller, had the best intentions and 5/5 reviews, I was perma banned for an overnight change in their policy against plastic props with no oppurtunity to remove the items or change, massively affecting my finances over night, and taking a succesfull business back to square one of which im still recovering today"
**Source:** https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.etsy.com
**source_type:** buyer_review
**verification_status:** could_not_verify
**Date:** 2025–2026
**Notes:** Trustpilot review found via Google search snippet. Exact review date not confirmed from index. Star Seller status, 5/5 reviews. Plastic props policy change. IP theft by Chinese sellers also mentioned in a separate passage of the same review. Degraded to Part 4 due to imprecise date.
